newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China bank to lend 1 bln yuan to petrochem sector.
newsitem.headline: China bank to lend 1 bln yuan to petrochem sector.

text.p: The Agricultural Bank of China plans to lend one billion yuan to state-owned China National Petrochemical Corp (SINOPEC) in 1997, the Shenzhen-based Securities Times said on Thursday.
The money would be put towards the development of China's petrochemical industry, and the two sdies had signed an agreement on the loan, the newspaper said.
There was no detail on the interest rate and maturity date.
The loan was an indication that the bank, traditionally a lender to the agricultural sector, had begun to participate in large-scale domestic industrial projects, the newspaper said.
The bank is one of China's four big state-owned commercial banks. The others are the Bank of China, the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China and Construction Bank of China.
